title: Trip-Hop
tagline: Slow tempos, dusty textures and a deep drift between beat and mood.
summary: Trip-hop blends beat-driven production with dub, soul and ambient textures, giving the music a restrained but cinematic atmosphere. It emerged in the 1990s as a style for late-night listening and club drift, with rhythm doing as much emotional work as melody. The result is often moody, spacious and slightly off-center.

pillars.name: Massive Attack
pillars.why: Massive Attack made trip-hop feel cinematic and spacious, balancing rhythm with atmosphere and mood.

pillars.name: Portishead
pillars.why: Portishead gave the style a darker, more vocal and melodic identity without losing its slow-burn command.

pillars.name: Tricky
pillars.why: Tricky brought a more fragmented, confrontational edge to the genre’s rhythmic language.
